name: foodics
description: Read-only Foodics restaurant analytics in ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Foodics business to explore sales, orders, menu, inventory, customers and restaurant performance in English or Arabic. All tools are read-only. Connection requires a Foodics business owner or a user authorized to manage apps. Data access follows the connected business account.
defaultPrompt: Compare my sales by branch last week.
What were my top-selling products this month?

positive.prompt: Compare my net sales by branch for last week.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize branch-level net sales and order counts, using branch names if available.

positive.prompt: How did my customers pay this month, by payment method?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize amount and count per payment method, accounting for returns.

positive.prompt: Show me the 5 latest orders from yesterday.
positive.expected_behavior: Fetch date-bounded orders with limit 5 and decode status/type from meta.enums; do not claim these are latest if ordering is not guaranteed.

positive.prompt: How many active products do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: Use is_active=true and count_only=true; report the count from metadata.

positive.prompt: كم كانت مبيعاتي في كل فرع الأسبوع الماضي؟
positive.expected_behavior: Answer in Arabic with branch-level figures from the authorized business.

negative.prompt: Change the price of my Chicken Shawarma to 25.
Show me the sales of another restaurant on Foodics.
List 100 customers in one go, limit 100.

review.commerce_description: Foodics MCP provides read-only business data and analytics. It does not place orders, process payments, or sell products through the plugin.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of Foodics read-only restaurant analytics with 74 MCP tools and English/Arabic queries.
